propertySets.name: Pset_CoveringFlooring
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of all occurrence and type objects of covering with the predefined type set to FLOORING.

properties.name: HasNonSkidSurface
properties.definition: Indication whether the surface finish is designed to prevent slippery (TRUE) or not (FALSE).

properties.name: HasAntiStaticSurface
properties.definition: Indication whether the surface finish is designed to prevent electrostatic charge (TRUE) or not (FALSE).
